messages:
Nina Wallace: Vendor VendPay submitted invoice VEN-2026-331 for $12,500 but our contract allowed a 10% reseller commission rebate. Their AP says they never received the rebate; invoice is due next week. Can someone confirm contract terms?

Ethan Moore: Pulling contract - SOW VendPay-2024 v2: reseller_commission_rebate=10% on gross monthly usage; rebate is remitted as a negative invoice/credit within 30 days. Looks like we missed issuing the rebate for May.

Nina Wallace: Customer provided invoice and statement showing no credit. They want either a corrected invoice or a direct payment. Our preference is to issue a vendor credit note so accounting matches.

Priya Shah: Agreed. Accounting prefers creating a vendor adjustment (VN-CN-405) for $1,250 (10% of 12,500) and apply as contra-invoice in June's pay run. Need approval for GL mapping: use vendor_rebates GL 4210. Also need Ops sign-off to ensure we don't double-pay.

Ethan Moore: I approve the vendor credit and will notify AP. Running command: 
```
/create-vendor-credit --vendor VendPay --invoice VEN-2026-331 --amount 1250 --currency USD --gl 4210 --reason "reseller commission rebate (May 2026)"
```

billing-bot: Vendor credit created VN-CN-405 amount $1,250 applied as contra to VEN-2026-331. Ledger note appended: "vendor rebate issued per SOW VendPay-2024 v2; remittance scheduled in June pay run". Posted to accounts payable queue GL 4210.

Priya Shah: Notified VendPay AP and cc'd Nina. Asked VendPay to confirm they will offset VN-CN-405 against next statement. Also added audit tag VEND_REBATE_MAY_2026.

Nina Wallace: VendPay replied "confirmed, will offset credit against June statement". Closing thread and filing a follow-up reminder for the June pay run.

Ethan Moore: Added internal note to vendor master: last_rebate_date=2026-05-31 and ticket FIN-2410 to automate rebate issuance.

Priya Shah: Thanks team. Keep the credit on file for audits.
thread_summary: Issued vendor credit VN-CN-405 for $1,250 to Vendor VendPay for a 10% reseller commission rebate on VEN-2026-331; credit scheduled to offset June pay run and audit tag VEND_REBATE_MAY_2026 added.
